summary: Tester could not build or run in a browser here (no emcc, no playwright locally), so only the static and WAD checks were run: they pass against the T2 sources. The WAD oracle matches the known E1M1 start (1056,-3616). Two proposals need a built dist/doom and exit 77 (skip) when it is absent. One checks MIME and subpath serving; the other checks tic, canvas, start position and stability in Chromium.

tests.purpose: Static checks of build.sh, index.html, doom-boot.js and the platform sources: six DG_TEST exports only, WAD preloaded, relative URLs, no threads, no network tools, no extra hooks.
Derives the E1M1 player-1 start THING from assets/doom1.wad (oracle for WAD-01.a) and checks it equals (1056,-3616).
Checks the dist/doom layout (one wasm, data present), then serves it at /doom/ and at /a/b/doom/ to check wasm MIME and that no path is hard-coded.

Playwright run under /doom/: tic>0 within 20 s, non-uniform canvas, no doomFatal or page errors, start position equals the WAD value in 16.16 fixed point, 8 s soak with tics rising, plus edge cases (lowercase warp, skill, no params, garbage params).
